verdict.rationale: Gitleaks documents a configuration format for writing your own secret detection rules (gh-5). It also supports composite rules with primary and required auxiliary rules (gh-7, gh-14) and per-rule allowlists to cut false positives (gh-20). A repo-root gitleaks.toml or a GITLEAKS_CONFIG path is picked up automatically in CI (docs-11), so organization-specific token formats can be encoded and enforced. Missing for 10: detailed evidence of rule fields (regex syntax, entropy thresholds, keywords), independent or hands-on corroboration of custom rules catching internal token formats.
